SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
MONDAY - OCTOBER 8, 2018 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
City Council Chamber
AGENDA MATERIALS: Reports and materials related to items on this Agenda are available for public inspection at the City Clerk's Office, Cerritos City Hall, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703, during normal business hours, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, Telephone (562) 916-1248. Materials submitted to the City Council/Successor Agency after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's Office at the above address during normal business hours as noted.
PUBLIC COMMENTS: For all Agenda Items, except for Consent Calendar Items, public comments will be allowed at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered. The general public comments portion of the meeting, under Agenda Item 6, will not exceed 45 minutes, and no speaker will be allowed more than five minutes, unless determined appropriate by the Chair. To assist in the preparation of appropriate responses, persons are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record.
PUBLIC HEARINGS: Public hearings will be conducted in the order indicated on the agenda, unless otherwise directed. Please complete and submit a blue Speakers Card if you wish to present testimony. Conduct of public hearings will occur in substantially the following sequence: the item to be heard is announced, a report of written correspondence and staff report are received, and the City Council asks questions of staff. The public hearing is opened and verbal testimony will occur in the following order: the applicant, if applicable, those in favor, opposed, or interested parties, and rebuttal by applicant. Speakers are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record. After verbal testimony, the public hearing is closed and the matter is deliberated with a determination being made or a continuation of the matter.

This section is reserved for comments related to Consent Calendar Items and items not listed on the Agenda but within the subject matter jurisdiction of the City Council/Successor Agency. Comments are limited to 5 minutes per person.

Items under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by one motion. Subject to the discretion of the City Council/Successor Agency, there will be no separate discussion of these items unless a Council/Agency Member or citizen so requests, in which event the item may be removed from the Consent Calendar and considered separately.

During this part of the meeting members of the City Council report to the community on various matters of interest, including reports concerning committees on which the Councilmembers serve and reports on meetings/conferences attended. In addition, requests may be made of the staff for reports which will be presented to the City Council at a subsequent meeting, or for the scheduling of future agenda items. There will be no discussion or action taken on any of the items that may be presented during this agenda item.

MINUTES OF A SPECIAL MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD ON
OCTOBER 8, 2018, IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBER AT CERRITOS CITY HALL, 18125
BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Pastor Paul Hansen, First Christian Reformed
  Church of Artesia.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Cerritos Recreation Services Division Youth
  Flag Football Pee Wee Team – Packers and Coach Mario Mejico.

4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in
  attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Jim Edwards
  Council/Agency Member Grace Hu
  Council/Agency Member Frank A. Yokoyama
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Naresh Solanki
  Mayor/Chair Mark E. Pulido

5.  Presentations/Appointments

5A.  A Proclamation was given to:

  Friends of the Cerritos Library (National Friends of Libraries Week).

5B.  Consideration of appointments to Commissions and Committees.

  MOTION: It was moved by Yokoyama, and seconded by Hu, to appoint Mei
  Pan to the Fine Arts and Historical Commission.

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Hu, Yokoyama, Solanki, Pulido
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  Soo Yoo, ABC Unified School District President, requested the City Council adopt
  a resolution in support of Measure BB.

  Ernie Nishii, ABC Unified School District Board Member, spoke in support of
  Measure BB.

  Sam Desai submitted a document for the record and expressed his opposition to
  Measure BB.
 City of Cerritos  October 8, 2018

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions (continued)

  Mel Cortez spoke regarding the reward status of the case involving Cerritos
  resident Sam Ferguson, Neighborhood Watch, Community Safety Town Hall and
  Hispanic Heritage Month.

  Benjamin Ao spoke in opposition to Measure BB.

  Parimal Shah spoke in opposition to Measure BB.

  John Darnell expressed support for Measure BB and requested the City Council
  adopt a resolution in support.

  Dan Mukerji spoke in opposition of Measure BB.

  Serina Yuan spoke in support of Measure BB and requested the City Council take
  action to endorse the measure.

  Josy Campbell spoke in opposition of Measure BB.

  Kirit Chauhan spoke in support of Measure BB.

  Daisy Lagasca spoke in opposition of Measure BB.

  Laura Walton spoke in support of Measure BB.

  Dan E. Dino spoke in opposition of Measure BB.

  Bipin Morari spoke in opposition of Measure BB.

  Jordan Monks spoke regarding Cerritos Parks restrictions regarding her bubble
  business.

  Renita Armstrong announced her candidacy for the Bellflower Unified School
  District Board.

  Paul W. Bellenbaum spoke regarding the 91 Freeway and his desire for a
  commuter train.

  MOTION DID NOT PASS: It was moved by Councilmember Yokoyama, and
  seconded by Pulido, to place an item on the next City Council meeting agenda
  to address the impacts to the City of Measure BB.

  The motion did not pass (2 – 3) as follows:

  AYES:  Yokoyama, Pulido
  NOES:  Edwards, Hu, Solanki
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7.  Consent Calendar
  Items under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by
  one motion. There will be no separate discussion of these items unless a
  Council/Agency Member or citizen so requests, in which event the item will be
  removed from the Consent Calendar and considered separately.
 City of Cerritos  October 8, 2018

7.  Consent Calendar (continued)

7A.  Approval of Minutes

  Approval of the City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of
  September 27, 2018 (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Solanki, and seconded by Edwards, to approve the City
  Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of September 27, 2018
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Hu, Yokoyama, Solanki, Pulido
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7B.  Approval of the Register of Demands

7B.1. Approval of the Register of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated October 8, 2018
  (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Solanki, and seconded by Edwards, to approve the
  Register of Demands as follows:

  City of Cerritos  10/08/2018  $4,098,414.23 (COUNCIL)

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Hu, Yokoyama, Solanki, Pulido
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7B.2. Approval of the Register of Demands for the Successor Agency to the
  Redevelopment Agency dated October 8, 2018 (SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Solanki, and seconded by Edwards, to approve the
  Register of Demands as follows:

  Successor Agency  10/08/2018  $14,200,866.25 (SUCCESSOR AGENCY)

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Hu, Yokoyama, Solanki, Pulido
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

8.  Public Hearings

  None.

9.  New and Old Business
9A.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF
  THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS ELECTING TO BE EXEMPT FROM
  THE CONGESTION MANAGEMENT PROGRAM (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Rebecca Scott, Management Analyst.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who elected
  to speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Hu, and seconded by Solanki, to waive full reading
  of and adopt Resolution No. 2018-17, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY
  COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS ELECTING TO BE EXEMPT FROM THE
  CONGESTION MANAGEMENT PROGRAM (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Hu, Yokoyama, Solanki, Pulido
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9B.  Review and consideration of approval of a utility agreement with the California
  Department of Transportation establishing the liability for the costs related to
  the relocation of streetlights on Valley View Avenue in connection with the I-5
  Corridor Improvement Project within the City of Cerritos (COUNCIL).
  (Continued from the meeting of September 27, 2018)

  A staff report was given by Dario Simoes, Assistant City Engineer. A PowerPoint
  Presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who
  elected to speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Edwards, and seconded by Hu, to authorize the City
  Manager to execute the Utility Agreement with CalTrans establishing the liability
  for the costs associated with the relocation of streetlights on Valley View Avenue
  within the City of Cerritos (COUNCIL).
  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:
  AYES:  Edwards, Hu, Yokoyama, Solanki, Pulido
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9C.  Review and consideration of award of Bid No. 1339-18, Supply, deliver, and
  install a booster pump, discharge head and related hardware for pump #2
  located at C-2 Booster Pump Station 16540 Marquardt Avenue, Cerritos,
  California (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Vince Brar, Senior Assistant City Manager.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who
  elected to speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  (continued next page)
 City of Cerritos  October 8, 2018
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 5 of 6

9.  New and Old Business (continued)
9C.  (continued)

  MOTION: It was moved by Solanki, and seconded by Edwards, to:

  1. Award Bid No. 1339-18 to General Pump Company, Inc. for the Supply,
  deliver, and install a booster pump, discharge head and related hardware for
  pump #2 C-2 Booster Pump Station 16540 Marquardt Avenue, in the
  amount of $89,750 with a one (1) year warranty term; and

  2. Authorize the City Manager or his designee to execute changes in the scope
  of work and related expenses, if necessary (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:
  AYES:  Edwards, Hu, Yokoyama, Solanki, Pulido
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9D.  Review and consideration of award of Bid No. 1353-18, Printing of the Cerritos
  Center for the Performing Arts 2018-2019 Calendar of Events (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Laurie Kajiwara, Public Information Manager.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who elected
  to speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Edwards, and seconded by Solanki, to award Bid
  No. 1353-18 for the Printing of the Cerritos Center for the Performing Arts
  2018-2019 Calendar of Events to ColorGraphics, Inc. in the amount of
  $48,476.51. In the event issues of non-performance arise, the project would be
  removed from ColorGraphics, Inc. and taken to the next lowest bidder to ensure
  the City’s printing deadline, quality standards and specifications are met. This
  process would be repeated as necessary in order of the lowest bid to the highest
  (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Hu, Yokoyama, Solanki, Pulido
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

10.  Legislative Items

  None.

11.  City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Report on Meetings

  Reports were provided by Councilmembers Edwards, Hu, and Yokoyama, Mayor
  Pro-Tem Solanki, and Mayor Pulido.

  CONSENSUS (Yokoyama): Directed staff to place a report on an upcoming
  agenda for City Council review and consideration of library card application fees
  and requirements.
 City of Cerritos  October 8, 2018

12.  Closed Session

  The City Council adjourned to Closed Session to discuss Item 12B as listed
  on the Closed Session agenda. Items 12A and 12C were not discussed.

12A.  PUBLIC EMPLOYEE PERFORMANCE EVALUATION
  Pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957 (COUNCIL)
  Title: City Manager

12B.  PUBLIC EMPLOYEE PERFORMANCE EVALUATION
  Pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957 (COUNCIL)
  Title: City Attorney

12C.  PUBLIC EMPLOYEE PERFORMANCE EVALUATION
  Pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957 (COUNCIL)
  Title: City Clerk

  REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION: The City Council reconvened into Open
  Session and the City Attorney reported the City Council discussed Item 12B as
  listed on the Closed Session agenda. There was no action taken and nothing
  further to report.

13.  Adjournment

  The meeting was adjourned at 10:45 p.m.
